acc.summary: The schedule as printed on the listing
body: Morning: one tablespoon of the sea moss gel. Afternoon: two Mag Flux capsules. Evening: two Decolonise capsules.
All capsules with at least 500 ml of spring water, and the listing asks for the schedule to be followed for a full 25 day cycle. That is the listing's own wording and this page does not add to it.
Decolonise is 25 days and then at least four months before another course, which is printed on its own sheet and does not change because the jar came in a box.

Activated charcoal is one of its nine declared ingredients. Charcoal can reduce how much of a medicine taken by mouth the body takes up, including the contraceptive pill, so leave at least two hours between the capsules and anything you take on prescription.
Not in pregnancy or while breastfeeding, and not if you are trying to conceive: that last one is the Purple Mwani listing's own caution and we print it as it stands. Not for children.

Anyone with epilepsy or a history of seizures should leave the Decolonise jar alone. Anyone with an overactive thyroid should leave the sea moss alone, and if you take thyroid medication or anything for the blood, ask your GP or pharmacist first. Yellow dock, in Mag Flux, is high in oxalate, so ask first if you have been told to keep oxalate down.

Sent out from 599 Smithdown Road, Liverpool, Tuesday to Sunday. A box with a gel in it goes out chilled. UK delivery is free over £50, or you can collect from the shop between 10 and 6, any day except Monday.

spec.caption: Parasite Cleanse Kit
rows: One jar of Mag Flux, 50 large vegan capsules. One jar of Decolonise, 50 vegan capsules. One jar of the Purple Mwani gel, Eucheuma cottonii and water.
£99.99. One size, listed with no variants.
£104.97 at the prices on this site: £39.99 plus £39.99 plus £24.99. The box is £4.98 under that.
As printed on the listing: one tablespoon of the gel in the morning, two Mag Flux capsules in the afternoon, two Decolonise capsules in the evening, all capsules with at least 500 ml of spring water.

A full 25 day cycle, as printed. Two jars of 50 capsules at two a day is 25 days, so the capsules and the cycle agree. The gel jar prints no volume, so how far it goes is not a figure we can give you.
Decolonise is up to 25 days and then at least four months before another course. That is on its own sheet and it applies to the jar in this box.
Gel: refrigerate, use within 28 days of opening or freeze, clean dry spoon. Capsules: lid on, cool and dry, no fridge.
No volume for the gel jar. No milligram split between the nine ingredients in Decolonise, and no thujone figure for the wormwood in it. This page fills none of those in.

Anyone who is pregnant, breastfeeding or trying to conceive. Children. Anyone with epilepsy or a history of seizures. Anyone with an overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism). If you take any prescribed medicine, including the contraceptive pill, thyroid medication or anything for the blood, speak to your GP or pharmacist before you start. If you have been advised to keep oxalate down, ask first: yellow dock is high in it.
spec.smallprint: Contains iodine from seaweed. Activated charcoal can reduce the absorption of medicines taken by mouth, including the contraceptive pill. Leave at least two hours between the capsules and any medication. Do not exceed the stated dose. Speak to your GP or pharmacist before starting any supplement, particularly if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or take medication. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of reach of young children.

doctrine.h3: We publish the specification. We do not publish claims about what it does.
doctrine.p: The sheet above is three jars, one schedule, one price and one limit. Parasite Cleanse Kit is the name printed on the box. It is a name, not a description, and we do not expand it or say what the box is for. What any of these three jars does in a body is not something we are permitted to tell you, so it is not on this page.

reiss.label: Reiss's turn
reiss.h2: The jar in the middle has a stop date
paras: Decolonise is 25 days and then four months on the shelf, and that limit does not soften because the jar arrived in a box with two others. It is on the sheet above in its own row for that reason. If somebody buys this in March, the earliest I would want them opening another Decolonise is July.

The second thing on that jar is the charcoal. Activated charcoal is one of the nine declared ingredients and charcoal is not selective about what it holds on to. If you take anything on prescription, including the pill, put two hours between it and the evening capsules. That is not caution for the sake of it, it is how charcoal behaves.

On the money: buy the three separately at the prices on this site and it comes to £104.97, so the box saves you £4.98. That is the whole of it. I have left the listing's own saving figure off this page because it does not agree with the shelf prices, and I would rather print the arithmetic you can check than the number that reads better.
reiss.pull: The earliest I would want you opening another Decolonise is four months after you close this one.
